cases.name: READY: editable valid draft retains the single explicit send action
SENDING before capture: visible original input is held and the send is disabled
SENDING after capture: typing remains available while a second send stays disabled
UNKNOWN without retry permission: edit locally and check the receipt without another send
UNKNOWN saved retry: current draft and earlier retry payload have distinct copy and action
CONFIRMED cleanup: editing remains possible while the recovery action cannot resubmit
Local save error: alert and explicit retry-save invoke only the local save callback
Save in progress: retry-save is disabled and the text remains editable
Terminal conversation: no composer or fresh send is exposed
CLOSED local erasure error: the formal copy matches its available sign-out action

boundaries: The actual GroupConversationPresentation, PillComposer and AccountClosingScreen execute under React test renderer.
Native surfaces, icons, scrolling and styling dependencies are inert boundaries; no Android rendering, keyboard, pixels or TalkBack execution is claimed.
Screen hooks are reviewed in source and covered separately by the production screen lifecycle suite; this focused UI probe does not replace storage/ACK/logout protocol tests.
No RPC, server, model, deploy, source edit or workflow dispatch is performed.
reviewedHookOwnership: draftModel memo identity includes accountId, accountRevision and agreementId; activate/dispose are in the matching effect.
useSyncExternalStore receives stable methods and a cached immutable snapshot; scope changes select a new model.
Focus and foreground controller lifetimes retain existing owner/session checks and clean up the timer and AppState listener.
SENDING input becomes editable only after durable capture and the published journal match request ID plus body hash; server send stays disabled.
No new send is enabled in UNKNOWN without retry authorization or CONFIRMED cleanup; those actions read a receipt or retire the confirmed local command.
Local save retry invokes only model.flush and remains fenced by the current screen owner and edit permission.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: No composer while a previous server send was pending
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Composer remains visible; typing after the original capture is sealed is allowed while sending another message is disabled.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: A failed local draft save had no explicit user retry
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Accessible error plus Sačuvajte nacrt ponovo invokes the local save callback and no send or refresh callback.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Recovery asked to retype a message already stored for retry
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Receipt check label and controller copy distinguish a saved-message retry from legacy reentry; newer visible text is preserved.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: CLOSED cleanup-error copy offered a missing check action and used informal older labels
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Copy and available action consistently direct the user to Odjavite se; touched closure labels use the formal address.

appendableRegressionSnippet.note: Independent adapter first used an exact string comparison for native T children, which this existing inert host wraps in an array. Adapter assertion corrected with React.Children.toArray and both tests passed; no production edit was made.
